## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes for code changes.
- [ ] Package build/check passes when packaging metadata changes.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] Research/evaluation changes preserve frozen historical evidence and clearly label new results.

## Compatibility

- [ ] No unintended public API or CLI breakage.
- [ ] Security and policy checks remain fail-closed.

## Evidence

Link any benchmark output, reproduction steps, issue, paper section, or external interoperability evidence relevant to this change.
